content:
[Stinger - open]
@voice bm_george
(break 2)
One spelling, two tellings.

[Verse 1 - two tellings]
@voice af_heart
(slot auto)
One spelling, two tellings, the letters never change,
The engine picks one, and the meaning rearranges,
Strange exchanges,
Plain and dangerous.
I read{reed} it today, and I read{red} it last night,
Same four letters on the page, but only one is right,
Hindsight.
A lead{leed} in the band, or the lead{led} in the pipe,
A tear{tare} in the page, or a tear{tier} that you wipe,
The spelling is a stencil, sound's another stripe,
Same type.
So tell the mouth which one you mean before it hits the mic.

[Verse 2 - the engine guessing]
@voice am_michael
(slot 2)
I'm guessing, I'm the engine,
No context, no attention,
I read{reed} it last evening,
The lead{leed} pipe is leaking,
A tear{tier} in the paper,
A bow{bough} tied on the wrapper,
I wind{winned} the clock later,
Each one a little vapour.

[Verse 3 - the fix]
@voice af_heart
(slot auto)
So mark it in the margin, put the sound in braces,
The cases get their faces, no more empty spaces,
Name and place it.
I read{red} it last evening, the lead{led} pipe is leaking,
A tear{tare} in the paper, hear the meaning speaking,
A bow{beau} tied on the wrapper, wind{wined} the clock later,
Greater.
Same voice, same page, same line, the same intent,
The only thing I changed in here was telling what I meant.
A sound that's marked will always beat a guessed one,
Lesson.
It reads the sign, and then it says the best one.

[Hook]
@voice bm_george
Same word, two sounds, say which one,
(which one!)
Mark the sound before the take is run,
Bow{beau} on the gift, bow{bough} when it's done,
(it's done!)
Write it how it's said, not how it's spun.
One spelling, two tellings, pick the one,
One spelling, two tellings, pick the one.
(break 2)

[Bridge]
@voice af_bella
It's quiet in the booth now,
The words come out as planned,
The letters and the meaning,
Are walking hand in hand.
Nobody hears the mark you made,
They only hear the word.

[Hook - last time]
@voice bm_george
Same word, two sounds, say which one,
(which one!)
Mark the sound before the take is run,
Bow{beau} on the gift, bow{bough} when it's done,
(it's done!)
Write it how it's said, not how it's spun.
One spelling, two tellings, pick the one,
One spelling, two tellings, pick the one.
